To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the use of test data in the manufacturing of the Motorola TETRA (Trans-European Trunked Radio) system has led to a significant improvement in the quality of the system, (b) test data has led to the reduction of cycle time, and (c) test data has been a significant contributor to the cost reduction of the TETRA system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: (1) How to use statistical process control techniques in a manufacturing environment that is not well understood.
the development of a new method for testing the quality of a radio system.

the use of test data to identify and correct the root cause of manufacturing problems, to identify the most effective corrective actions and to identify the best time for corrective action in order to improve quality and reduce cycle time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this thesis has provided a method for the effective use of test data to reduce cycle time in a radio system manufacturing environment, which has been applied and proven to be effective in the real world.

the data analysis and statistical process control techniques presented herein are very effective and useful tools in the improvement of manufacturing processes, especially in the area of radio system manufacturing.
the test data is an important source of information for quality improvement and process improvement.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the data we collected and analyzed has been very helpful in understanding our manufacturing process.
we have developed a methodology for using test data to identify and eliminate defects in manufacturing.

we have developed a methodology to improve product quality and reduce cycle time in radio system manufacturing through the effective use of test data and the use of the test data in a statistical quality control environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quality of the test data can have a significant impact on cycle time reduction and quality improvement efforts.
the use of test data is a powerful tool to improve the quality of a product and reduce the cycle time in a manufacturing process.

it is possible to achieve a high level of accuracy in the prediction of the performance of a radio system by combining a small amount of real test data with a large amount of simulation data, provided the simulation data is accurate and the test data is representative of the population.
